summary: Members can append an item to a physical group on the selected browser board. The group form owns the draft UUID and spelling; store::create_group_item locks the active group, allocates its next position and records the creator inside the authorized write transaction. The browser refreshes the group counts and rows after acknowledgment.
evidence: browser_creates_item_in_selected_group passed. At the last Work on board 201, blank Enter and Escape sent no POST. Enter on 128 emoji sent one POST to the selected items path (422); the field retained the text and offered Retry. A fresh connection found no row under the proposed UUID. Correcting to ' Ink ' used the same UUID. While the group lock was held the field was disabled and showed Saving; neither Chromium nor PostgreSQL showed an append.

After lock release the POST returned that UUID, g-20, Ink and revision 1. One selected GET showed two Ink rows, 59 followed by the new UUID; the field was empty. Reload resolved the original session and fetched 201 once at the same history entry, with no list, login or repeated POST. Fresh reads confirmed position 1 and the creator, the first Work, empty Reserve, archived item 57, board 202 and direct target, plus original grants and session. This matches the recorded reference fixture's ordering using an explicit append position.

browser_demoted_viewer_cannot_create_item passed. Demoting the Member after typing but before Enter produced one POST (403), then one selected GET (200). All three groups remained visible with disabled add controls. Reload kept the same Viewer session and read-only rows without a write or second login; independent reads confirmed unchanged counts, titles, positions and revisions.

preview_create_requires_current_group_access passed: missing and revoked sessions returned 401, removed workspace membership returned 403, and archived, missing and foreign groups returned 422. Denials returned empty bodies. Neither native paths nor non-preview hosts exposed the create route.

preview_create_is_atomic_and_replay_safe passed: blank, nil ID and 256 UTF-16 units returned 422. A padded 255-unit title committed at position zero in Reserve. A fresh connection replayed it without a second row or revision. Mismatched title, group, creator, snapshot ID and sibling board ID did not overwrite or disclose a row. A deferred trigger forced commit failure (500); a reconnect before fault removal found no new item or creation provenance. The grouped and flat bearer reads agreed on the committed append.

All 14 browser_preview journeys and all 15 loopback_board_access cases passed serially, including the populated v2 migration and inactive group checks. The locked workspace suite passed 30 tests. Cargo used the separate target-browser-packets directory. Workspace formatting and git diff --check passed. The shell denied node --test scripts/run.test.mjs before execution, so runner regressions remain for coordinator verification.
